I can do that — quick clarifying questions before I update your calendar:

1) Which Friday do you mean? (this coming Friday, July 17, 2026, or a different date?)  
2) Which "Design Review" event should I move? (give the current date/time, or confirm it's the single event titled “Design Review” on your calendar)  
3) Time zone to use (your calendar default? or specify) and desired duration (default 60 minutes)?  
4) I’ll interpret “Friday afternoon” as 1:00–5:00 PM and propose 3:00–4:00 PM as a sensible time — is that OK or would you prefer another time?  
5) Should I check attendees’ availability and pick the best slot, or just move to the time above?  
6) Should I send updated invitations/notifications to all current attendees? (default: yes)

Reply with your choices (or “go ahead” if the defaults are fine) and I’ll proceed.
